# Copilot instructions

Follow **[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** at the repository root. That file is the canonical, LLM-agnostic instruction set for this project (pipeline, hard rules, style, acceptance, commands).

Stage procedures are in `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. Channel look is in `docs/STYLE_BRIEF.md`. The ship checklist is in `docs/ACCEPTANCE.md`.

Do not publish or upload anything. Wait for human approval at the angle, script, and final-video gates.
